data.notes: October 2026 in Miami is anchored by III Points and its citywide Satellite program, with Caribbean Carnival, Latin arena shows, Factory Town/Club Space marathons, and diaspora-rooted community festivals filling out the month.

events.title: III Points 2026
events.summary: III Points returns to Mana Wynwood for two nights across 13 stages, with the official site listing October 16–17 and a 2026 lineup of hundreds of artists.

events.title: Hocus Pocus 2026
events.summary: Factory Town’s Hocus Pocus returns for three Halloween-season nights across five stages with more than 100 artists, including Âme b2b Marcel Dettmann, Apollonia, Baauer b2b Hudson Mohawke, Chase & Status and many more.

events.title: III Points Satellite: 33+ Hour Closing Party
events.summary: III Points Satellite closes at Club Space with a 33+ hour marathon from Sunday night to Tuesday, listing Honey Dijon, Marco Carola, Seth Troxler b2b Maher Daniel, Ben Sterling b2b Tiga, Adam Ten b2b Mita Gami and more.

events.title: Miami Carnival Parade & Fete
events.venueName: Central Broward Park & Broward County Stadium
events.summary: Miami Carnival’s finale runs 11:00 AM–11:00 PM with masquerade bands, Caribbean music, steelpan, live entertainment, food village programming, and a post-parade fete.

events.title: III Points Satellite: Disco Lines, Four Tet b2b Floating Points b2b Daphni & more
events.summary: III Points Satellite’s Saturday Club Space bill includes Disco Lines, Four Tet b2b Floating Points b2b Daphni, horsegiirL, Kettama, VTSS, MPH, Marte and Roddy Lima.

events.title: III Points Satellite: 999999999, KI/KI, Roman Flügel b2b Danny Daze & more
events.summary: Club Space’s Friday III Points Satellite bill features 999999999, KI/KI, Roman Flügel b2b Danny Daze, ¥ØU$UK€ ¥UK1MAT$U, David Vunk, DJ Three, Priori and more.

events.title: III Points Satellite: Cloonee, Miluhska, Omar+ & Vintage Culture
events.summary: III Points Satellite lists a Club Space night with Cloonee, Miluhska, Omar+ and Vintage Culture, with doors at 11:00 PM.

events.title: iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina
events.summary: Kaseya Center hosts iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina at 8:00 PM; Ticketmaster’s event page lists performers including Anuel AA, Myke Towers, Farruko, Manuel Turizo, Eladio Carrión, FloyyMenor, Greeicy, Alleh and Rey Tony.

events.title: Miami Carnival Parade and Concert 2026
events.summary: Official Miami Carnival Sunday Parade and Fete, anchoring the region’s Caribbean soca, calypso, steelpan and mas weekend.

events.title: Satellite: Disco Lines, Four Tet B2B Floating Points B2B Daphni, horsegiirL, Kettama + MORE
events.summary: A marathon Terrace Satellite party at Club Space with Four Tet, Floating Points and Daphni in a rare b2b, plus Disco Lines, horsegiirL, Kettama, VTSS and more.

events.title: Armin van Buuren presents The Orb
events.summary: Armin van Buuren brings The Orb to Factory Town with Funk Tribu and NRG2000, billed by Insomniac as a trance/techno production from 10:00 PM to 5:00 AM.

events.title: Black Coffee at LIV Nightclub
events.summary: South African house icon Black Coffee brings deep, soulful Afro-house to LIV for a late-night Fontainebleau club set.

events.title: PERREO DEL FUTURO Halloween
events.summary: PERREO DEL FUTURO’s Halloween edition at The Ground pairs TSVI / Anunaku, Manuka Honey, yung_womb, MARACUYá, SATURNSARii and Mr. Bitch for a reggaeton, dembow, techno and bass-focused night.

events.title: Young Miko - Late Checkout Tour
events.summary: Young Miko’s Late Checkout Tour stops at Kaseya Center for an 8:00 PM Miami arena date.

events.title: WORSHIP at Factory Town
events.summary: WORSHIP brings Sub Focus, Dimension, Culture Shock, and 1991 to Factory Town for a late-night drum-and-bass/electronic event starting at 10:00 PM.

events.title: TINI - FUTTTURA World Tour
events.summary: Argentine pop artist TINI brings the FUTTTURA World Tour to Kaseya Center for an 8:00 PM Miami date.

events.title: Soundtuary present AMÉMÉ & Malive - Open Air
events.summary: Soundtuary’s open-air Afro-house experience brings AMÉMÉ and Malive to Jungle Island with a boho-dress-code, outdoor-market, food-truck and late-night dance setup.

events.title: Satellite: The Pickle x III Points
events.summary: Official III Points Satellite afterparty at The Pickle, billed as a 12-hour session of house, electronica and afterhours sounds from special guests.

events.title: KAROL G - VIAJANDO POR EL MUNDO TROPITOUR
events.summary: Karol G brings her Viajando Por El Mundo Tropitour to Hard Rock Stadium in Miami Gardens for a large-scale Latin pop/reggaeton stadium date.

events.title: Miami Carnival J’ouvert
events.summary: Official Miami Carnival J’ouvert: a cornerstone Caribbean road-party ritual with soca/calypso bands, paint/mud/oil traditions, and pre-parade Carnival energy.

events.title: Eros Ramazzotti - Una Historia Importante
events.summary: Italian pop star Eros Ramazzotti brings his Una Historia Importante tour to Kaseya Center for a Halloween-night Miami concert.

events.title: One Fete Miami 2026
events.summary: Soca-forward Miami Carnival weekend festival listing featuring Jadel Legere, whose sound crosses soca, dancehall, Afropop, R&B and reggae.

events.title: Camilo - USA 2026 Tour
events.summary: Camilo’s USA 2026 Tour stop at Kaseya Center is a rescheduled Miami date, with the Colombian artist bringing his Latin pop catalog to the arena.

events.title: Kany Garcia - Puerta Abierta Tour
events.summary: Puerto Rican singer-songwriter Kany Garcia brings her Puerta Abierta Tour to Kaseya Center for a Saturday night Latin pop concert.

events.title: Reggae Fest Blaze Miami with Aidonia
events.summary: Reggae Fest Blaze Miami returns to Wynwood Marketplace with Jamaican dancehall artist Aidonia headlining, plus DJ-driven reggae, soca and Caribbean party sets.

events.title: Fete Republic Night Carnival Miami
events.summary: Fete Republic’s Monday Wear/Carnival-costume street-festival concept returns for Miami Carnival weekend as a 21+ Friday-night fete.

events.title: Black Country, New Road
events.summary: Black Country, New Road perform at Miami Beach Bandshell in a show presented by AEG, highlighting the band’s post-rock, jazz and chamber-pop direction.

events.title: STAMPED x Jerk X Jollof: Miami Carnival Poolside
events.summary: STAMPED and Jerk x Jollof team up for an eight-hour Miami Carnival poolside party at Arlo Wynwood, focused on African and Caribbean diaspora club sounds.

events.title: Bethel Music 2026 Tour
events.venueName: The Fillmore Miami Beach at The Jackie Gleason Theatre
events.summary: Bethel Music brings its 2026 Tour to The Fillmore Miami Beach for a Sunday evening contemporary worship concert.

events.title: Bad Gyal: Más Cara World Tour
events.venueName: The Fillmore Miami Beach at Jackie Gleason Theater
events.summary: Spanish urbano/dancehall-pop artist Bad Gyal opens the U.S. leg of her Más Cara World Tour in Miami Beach, a strong Latin club-culture crossover booking outside the arena circuit.

events.title: The Shrine: Afrobeats + Caribbean Heat
events.summary: Weekly Saturday upstairs dance-floor series in Overtown rooted in Afrobeats, amapiano and Caribbean sounds, running through late November 2026.

events.title: Akeem Ali: The Texture Tour
events.summary: Hip-hop artist Akeem Ali brings The Texture Tour to Wynwood’s Midline Miami, presented by Reaction Presents and Bowe Inc for an 18+ audience.
